result.rationale: Verified: admin-embedding.js.es6 defines saveChanges which calls this.get('embedding').update({}), but embedding.hbs contains no element invoking a saveChanges action (only addHost). The backend embedding_controller.rb update action just re-renders the serializer via fetch_embedding without persisting anything — a no-op. So this is a real, specific observation about dead code/incomplete wiring introduced by this diff, not a hallucination, though it is not itself a user-visible defect.

adjudication.rationale: In the new `admin-embedding` controller, `actions.saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` (empty payload). In the added `embedding.hbs` template, there is no button or action wiring that invokes `saveChanges` (only per-host save/delete via `embeddable-host` and an `addHost` button). Also, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serializer without applying changes, making the endpoint effectively a no-op as shown. This is a concrete maintainability/unused-code issue rather than a user-facing defect in the diff.
